why_MD_S079_contributes_zero_promotions.reason: MD-S079 already carries 36 REQUIRED rows covering its operative obligations: the unknown-action-type policy (R0111 to R0118), the forbidden-behaviour list promoted in MD-B11-A002, the dictionary table contract, the capability boundary, and the current event-lifecycle corrections (R0154 to R0160).
why_MD_S079_contributes_zero_promotions.what_remains: Hard-wrapped narrative and enum vocabulary. The document wraps at roughly 100 characters, so most rows are continuation lines whose predicates complete in a REQUIRED sibling - for example R0109 opens the unknown-type rule and R0111 to R0113 carry it, and those are REQUIRED.
why_MD_S079_contributes_zero_promotions.this_is_not_convenience: The obligations are genuinely already owned. Promoting the fragments would duplicate a closure obligation contrary to section 7, and would bind predicates to text that does not state them.

guard_coverage_verified_before_promoting.method: All 28 guard methods across the 14 proof families were checked to exist by name before any promotion was applied, and every rule-family override was checked to resolve to a defined family.
guard_coverage_verified_before_promoting.result: 28 guard methods checked, 0 missing, 0 orphan overrides.
guard_coverage_verified_before_promoting.why_five_new_families_were_needed: MD-B11 assigns proof families per document. Four of the five promoted groups would have inherited a family whose guards do not prove them: MD-S080 rows would have inherited detector-only guards, MD-S010 rows would have inherited window-contamination guards, and the MD-S084 detector-authority and idempotency rules needed their own. Binding them to the document default would have claimed proof those families do not carry.

the_gap_ambiguous_rules_are_satisfied_by.finding: MD-B11-A002 established that continuity_check_status, observed_gap_pct, GAP_BEYOND_EXCHANGE_BAND and GAP_AMBIGUOUS appear in zero files under app, config and routes.
the_gap_ambiguous_rules_are_satisfied_by.consequence: No code path resolves GAP_AMBIGUOUS by any means, correct or incorrect. Both the permissions and the prohibitions hold by construction, and the structural guard written in A002 is what pins that. This is recorded plainly rather than presented as behavioural proof of a branch that does not exist.

review_pass_guards.completeness_re_scanned_after_the_pass: The pass re-scans MD-B11 after writing and aborts if any non-structural reference row is still undecided. Checking before the pass would only confirm the input; checking after confirms the claim that admits the stage.
review_pass_guards.falsifiability_completeness: Suppressing the recording for MD-S079 made the pass abort reporting MD-S079-R0001 undecided.
review_pass_guards.falsifiability_named_promotions: Renaming MD-S084-R0045 to a non-existent id made the pass abort naming it.
review_pass_guards.falsifiability_foreign_rows: Injecting a mutation on MD-S083-R0032, a MD-B12 row, made the pass abort naming the row and its owning stage.
review_pass_guards.start_state_verified: A promoted rule must have been REFERENCE_ONLY beforehand, so a no-op cannot look like work.

reference_decision_form.what: The 137 decisions are generated from a section-level basis rather than 137 hand-written strings.
reference_decision_form.why: Rows inside one section are the same kind of text - a wrapped sentence, an enum definition, a capability disclaimer. A per-row string would repeat rather than inform.
reference_decision_form.attribution: Each basis names the document and section it was derived from, so the call stays attributable and can be challenged at the level it was actually made.
reference_decision_form.honest_limit: A generated basis proves a pass considered the section, not that a human weighed every sentence. That limit is the same one recorded in the classification gate docblock at MD-B00-A004.
